body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Bilbao, Spain. The listing gives its length as 3 – 3.5 hours, over a route of about 6 km. It starts at Guggenheim Museum Bilbao, Abandoibarra Etorb., 2, Abando, 48009 Bilbao, Bizkaia, Spain. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entry ticket to the Guggenheim Museum Bilbao. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone. WeGoTrip names Anna as the tour's author.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Immerse yourself in the vibrant culture of Bilbao with a combined ticket to the iconic Guggenheim Museum, which includes an optional audio guide that brings the city’s history and artistry to life. Enter a world of contemporary masterpieces within one of the most architecturally significant buildings globally. The museum's flowing curves and organic shapes, designed by renowned architect Frank Gehry, create an extraordinary artistic experience.
>
> This audio tour is designed to be a half-day experience, allowing you to explore at your own pace and fully appreciate everything Bilbao has to offer. It connects you to the essence of Bilbao, leading you past colorful street art, stylish galleries, and the renowned Museum of Fine Arts, famous for its impressive collections from medieval to contemporary art.
>
> Take a stroll through the cobbled streets of Casco Viejo, the historic heart of Bilbao, rich in stories and traditions. Here, you'll experience a delightful mix of old and new, with traditional pintxos bars inviting you to savor the aromas of Basque cuisine. Every twist and turn presents a new surprise, immersing you in the city's dynamic energy.
>
> Your tour ends at the Fingerprint Sculpture, a fun installation where you can leave your own mark on your visit to Bilbao. This playful artwork reminds you that every visitor is unique, showing the individuality present throughout this lively city.
